title: Identity-square tensor transport agrees under the identity pullback unitors
statement: Fix a finite commutative ring $A$, an open immersion $i:W\hookrightarrow Y$, objects $R,H\in D_A(Y)$, $P,Q\in D_A(W)$ and any arrow $f:R\otimes H\to i_!(P\otimes Q)$ in the ordinary unbounded fixed-scalar categories of [def-sf-finite-open-tensor-operations]. Let $e_T:(1_T)^*\simeq 1$ be obtained by deriving the canonical inverse-image identity isomorphism, and $\beta$ the specified open base change for the identity square. Then $(\mu_{1_Y}^{-1};(1_Y)^*f;\beta;i_!\mu_{1_W});i_!(e_W(P)\otimes e_W(Q))=(e_Y(R)\otimes e_Y(H));f$. No unit equation, support hypothesis on the factors, or invertibility of $f$ is required.

proof.text: Let e be the displayed derived identity-pullback unitor. The canonical identity-square beta satisfies beta;J(e_W)=e_Y(J(-)); tensor compatibility gives mu_id;tensor(e,e)=e(tensor(-,-)). Insert both equations into the left side, using J.map_comp. Naturality of e_Y at f moves pull_id(f) past e_Y at J(P tensor Q). The remaining mu_id inverse cancels mu_id. The beta identity is the identity coherence of inverse-image composition passed through adjunction mates, and the tensor identity follows termwise from the ordinary identity pullback's monoidal comparison. Both identities descend on flat-term K-flat representatives and hence apply to arbitrary unbounded objects. This proves the displayed equality without imposing an equation on f.

lean.statement:
theorem supportedTensor_identity_unitor
    {W Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : W ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion i]
    (R H : FiniteD A Y) (P Q : FiniteD A W)
    (f : tensor A Y R H ⟶ (finiteShriek A i).obj (tensor A W P Q)) :
    let eW := Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
      (ProEtale.upperStarId (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) W) ≪≫
        Functor.mapDerivedCategoryIdIso _
    let eY := Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
      (ProEtale.upperStarId (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Y) ≪≫
        Functor.mapDerivedCategoryIdIso _
    ((tensorPullIso A (𝟙 Y) R H).inv ≫ (pull A (𝟙 Y)).map f ≫
      (beta A (𝟙 W) i i (𝟙 Y) (IsPullback.of_id_fst (f := i))).hom.app
        (tensor A W P Q) ≫ (finiteShriek A i).map (tensorPullIso A (𝟙 W) P Q).hom) ≫
      (finiteShriek A i).map (tensorMap A W (eW.hom.app P) (eW.hom.app Q)) =
      tensorMap A Y (eY.hom.app R) (eY.hom.app H) ≫ f
